goal: Turn the studied browse grammar into an original light two-column inspector where choosing a row restages one signal, instead of repeating a dark card grid.
core_concept: A warm paper instrument: a numbered index of fictional signals occupies a narrow left column; the right stage restages the selected signal as a single large field. Browsing is selection, not a shelf of equal tiles.

sections: masthead with original practice name and inspector status
numbered index column of signal rows
dominant stage field that restages the selected signal
quiet end note and return control
composition_plan.spatial_system: Desktop is a two-column inspector: 28% index, 72% stage. No third support rail. Mobile stacks the masthead, a compact index, then the stage.
composition_plan.visual_hierarchy: The stage is the primary surface; index numbers and names are secondary; annotations are tertiary.
composition_plan.pacing: Short masthead, then a long selected stage, then a compact closing note. Avoid equal card bands.
composition_plan.density: Sparse paper around the stage; denser type in the index.

typography_plan.display_role: A large system serif for the stage title; no source fonts.
typography_plan.body_role: A compact system sans for the index and annotations.
typography_plan.scale_strategy: Clamp the stage title large and keep index names small and tabular.
typography_plan.contrast_strategy: Ink on warm paper; one rust index marker instead of violet gradients.
typography_plan.rhythm: Tabular numbers, hairline rules, and a single wide stage measure.
typography_plan.responsive_behavior: Stage title stacks; index becomes a horizontal scroller of names without overlapping the stage.

art_direction.imagery_strategy: CSS-only paper grain, hairlines, and one geometric stage motif per selected row. No source media.
art_direction.asset_strategy: Inline HTML/CSS/JS only; no external assets, fonts, or libraries.
art_direction.texture: Warm paper with a faint CSS grain and hairline rules.
art_direction.material: Matte paper, rust marker, graphite ink.
art_direction.depth: Depth is a drawn reticle and inset stage well, not hover-lifted cards.
art_direction.color_logic: Warm paper and graphite ink; rust marks the selected index and reticle.

signature_move.name: stage reticle
signature_move.central_idea: Selecting an index row draws a reticle around the stage motif so the chosen signal is the only restaged object.
signature_move.trigger: pointer hover or keyboard focus on the first index row
signature_move.visual_transformation: A hairline reticle scales from the kinetic soft scale to identity around the stage motif while the row marker becomes rust.
signature_move.purpose: Make selection mean restaging, not decorating a card.
signature_move.content_relationship: The reticle belongs to the selected signal's stage motif and name.
signature_move.reduced_motion_alternative: Show the reticle and rust marker in their final positions with no scale or transition.
signature_move.capture_checkpoint: desktop hover on the first index row after a 1250ms stable checkpoint

scroll_storyboard: initial: masthead, first index rows, and empty-to-selected stage
mid-scroll: later index rows and annotation strip
signature: first row restages the motif with a drawn reticle
final: closing note and return control
transitions: use duration-slow and easing-out-expo for the reticle
use duration-med and easing-out-quint for row marker color
disable transitions and transforms under prefers-reduced-motion
interaction_states: index row hover/focus restages the stage
mobile menu reveals the index list
return control moves focus to the masthead
motion_plan.reduced_motion_behavior: Remove transitions and transforms; keep the reticle, rust marker, hierarchy, and focus styles at rest.

retained_principles: keep browsing as the primary task
one focused interaction explains the selected preview
separate navigation from the visual field
deliberately_rejected_principles: violet/magenta preview gradients as the identity
prohibited_copying: React Bits source, branding, copy, fonts, media, or components
V0 Signal Shelf geometry, labels, or CSS

design_reference_sources.retrieval_reason: Use the audited React Bits reference only for abstract browse-task principles while composing an original inspector that is not a gallery clone.
knowledge_used: dark application shell separates a left navigation rail, central gallery, and right support rail
repeated rounded preview panels with compact metadata make a large catalogue browseable
violet, magenta, and electric-blue gradients are concentrated in previews and primary actions
search, category filtering, theme/preferences, and card focus states are explicit browse affordances
preview motion is observed as an interaction intent only; exact timing and implementation remain unclaimed

composition_differences: Replace the three-rail dark shelf with a two-column light inspector and a single stage.
Use numbered index rows instead of equal preview tiles.
Drop the right support rail entirely.
typography_differences: Use serif display on the stage against sans index names.
Use rust/graphite on paper instead of luminous dark UI type.
motion_differences: Signature is a stage reticle on selection, not a card constellation lift.
No tile hover lift; the index marker and reticle carry the state.
originality_plan.asset_non_reuse: All visuals are original CSS geometry; no source or V0 motifs are reused.
originality_plan.signature_move_hypothesis: A drawn reticle on the stage should prove that browsing can mean restaging one object rather than lifting a card.

quality_hypothesis: A light inspector with one dominant stage should feel like a different major direction from the dark catalogue while remaining an original, technically complete page. Human review must decide taste; no winner is inferred.
